findings.title: File download joins the raw name into the uploads path
findings.evidence: src/routes/files.ts:9 takes req.params.name; src/routes/files.ts:11 joins it to UPLOADS with no normalisation and reads the result.

findings.title: Admin stats route is mounted without authentication
findings.attacker: Anyone who can reach the server
findings.evidence: src/app.ts:12 mounts adminRouter without requireAuth, so src/routes/admin.ts:7 answers anonymous requests.
